title: The Line That Wouldn't Move
narrativeQuestion: Why did the Western Front resist the rapid breakthrough commanders expected?

chapters.title: A defensive system
chapters.claim: Front lines, support lines, reserves and communication trenches formed a network.

chapters.title: A day in the trench
chapters.claim: Stand-to, work, waiting and supply changed through the day.

chapters.title: A weapon is not a win
chapters.claim: Machine guns, artillery, wire and logistics changed offensive choices.

chapters.title: The Somme chronology
chapters.claim: July 1 and September tank use are separate events. Casualties include deaths, wounded, missing and captured.

chapters.title: Explain the evidence
chapters.claim: Evidence supports some claims and exposes misleading generalizations.
